title: Ordinary geometric images at the constant quotient levels
statement: Given the sites, coefficient ring O, element ell, and left exact geometric adjunction L⊣V of [def-pur-coefficient-system-image-data], there exist simultaneous algebraic inverse images on the specified constant quotient-ring module categories. Their underlying ring maps fix each constant generator; their module functors are additive and exact, have normalized right adjoints over V, and commute with every scalar restriction. The corresponding right-restriction comparisons are invertible and satisfy the explicit ordinary-transpose mate equation. This statement involves only the individual module categories; it does not assert an adjunction on systems or construct any derived functors. No regularity or completeness of O is needed.

proof.text: Construct the constant-sheaf comparison from copowers of the terminal object: L preserves copowers by adjunction and the terminal object by left exactness. It fixes all scalar generators. Transport ring and module operations through the finite-product comparison and identify the transported quotient ring with the specified constant quotient ring.

Lift the underlying set-sheaf adjunction to modules by transposing addition and scalar-action diagrams; the normalization on underlying maps is the original Hom bijection. The geometric inverse image is exact.

Restricting a scalar action before or after transport gives the same operation. The identity on the underlying sheaf gives the inverse-image comparison and the direct-image comparison. Transpose that identity to obtain the stated mate equation for each quotient map.
